extraction_metadata.extraction_notes: Single SoA table (section 1.3, protocol J2G-MC-JZPA) printed over document pages 9-12 with the header reprinted on every page; extracted as one table. Pages 9-11 are vector text-layer pages (marks verified by pdftotext -bbox column binning). Page 12 is a full-page raster with an invisible glyph-spread text layer; marks cross-checked by bbox, arrows read visually. A 'CCI' redaction box on page 12 may conceal activity rows. Label columns L=1 (Procedure); data columns 2-16; the right-hand Comments column (17) is a notes column rendered as footnote annotations with synthesized markers cm1-cm8. In-grid mark 'P' has no printed legend.

table_metadata.table_purpose: Main study schedule: screening, 11-day inpatient treatment period, ED and follow-up phone call
table_metadata.notes: Only SoA table in the excerpt; primary anchor grid -> main_soa. The header reprints on pages 10-12 with identical columns and the rows continue; no separate table number or caption, so treated as one table spanning 9-12 (not a continuation).

schedule_properties.property_comment: Top header band naming study phases: Screening (col 2), Treatment Period (merged across cols 3-15, Day -1 to ED), Follow-Up phone call (col 16). Phase names -> epoch. Label cell empty; name synthesized.

Presentational band carrying the single spanning label 'Days' over cols 3-15, qualifying the numbers in row 3 as study days. It does not by itself distinguish any two columns, so hierarchical_level is null. Label cell empty; name taken from the spanning value.

Study-day row: '-28 to -2 days prior to Day 1' (Screening), Day -1, Days 1-11, ED (early discontinuation), and for the Follow-Up column the window 'within 7 to 10 days after last dose' (vertically merged across rows 2-3 in the source). Numeric day labels -> study_day. The printed label cell reads 'Procedure', which heads the activity column, so the property name is synthesized.

annotations.annotation_text: A study participant may be required to stay later than Day 11 for management or monitoring of an AE or a clinically significant finding, at the discretion of the investigator.
Full medical assessment to be performed at screening, and symptom driven examination to be done at other/any time point at physician’s discretion.
Height and weight to be measured at screening; weight only to be measured at Day 11 or ED as appropriate.
Serum pregnancy tests will be performed at screening and urine pregnancy test at all other time points
Time points may be added, if warranted and agreed upon between Lilly and the investigator.
See Appendix 10.2, Clinical Laboratory Tests, for details.
Participant consumes high-fat meal within 30 minutes prior to dose based on randomization.

review_items.call_made: The black 'CCI' redaction box between 'Genetic sample' and 'Selpercatinib administration' (full table width) is treated as hiding unknown content; no activity rows were created for it.
review_items.alternative: Add one or more placeholder activity rows (e.g. 'Redacted (CCI)') with no marks, so the concealed rows are represented in the schedule.

review_items.call_made: The double-headed arrow in 'Adverse event /Serious adverse event review' and 'Concomitant medication review' is recorded as one merged cell covering Day 1 to Day 11 (columns 4-14), and is distributed as '↔' to each of those 11 columns.
review_items.alternative: Limit the arrow to the columns the drawn arrow physically crosses (tip-to-tip roughly Day 1 to Day 10) instead of the full merged cell.

review_items.call_made: The Follow-Up column's text 'within 7 to 10 days after last dose', printed in a cell merged down across header rows 2-3, is stored on the study-day row (row 3); row 2 is left empty for that column.
review_items.alternative: Store it as a separate visit-window property, or on row 2, since the source cell spans both rows.

review_items.call_made: The abbreviation line under the table (CRU, ECG, ED, h; tail redacted as CCI) is not emitted as annotations, because none of these terms is printed as a marker; they only occur as ordinary words in labels and cells.
review_items.alternative: Emit abbreviation annotations ab1-ab4 (CRU, ECG, ED, h) bound to the labels/cells where those words appear.
